d: Sailing to Bell Island, Newfoundland, where the investigators reach out to the ghosts left by a devastating Nazi U-boat attack during WW II; descending into darkness as the trio reveals a group of ghostly miners trapped underground for 80 years.

The team investigates paranormal activity linked to an overwhelming number of natural disasters, contacts spirits in a hotel built atop a hospital, explores an eerie B & B, and finds troubled souls in America's most haunted city.
Following paranormal investigators Leanne Sallenback, Kelly Ireland and Corine Carey as they begin their travels up British Columbia's famed gold rush trail to explore its history and its hauntings.
Haunted Gold Rush follows paranormal investigators Leanne Sallenback, Kelly Ireland and Corine Carey as they travel British Columbia's famed gold rush trail and explore its history and its hauntings.

New tools bridge a ghostly divide as the investigators reach out to old acquaintances at the Conrad-Caldwell House Museum; considering fresh data and insights into the Kentucky Anomaly that could help Brandon get to the heart of this haunting.

Hunting for restless souls in a coal mine that stands near a purported mass grave; examining the data after the team conducts a series of paranormal experiments and finding out if a living man's visits are keeping a departed spirit attached.
Confronting the bloody, greedy past of Benham, Kentucky, where an ominous mountain and a historic mining conflict have turned the land into a hotbed of paranormal activity.

Looking for proof of apparitions, eerie voices and other inexplicable phenomena inside a grim execution site; the team explores Harlan County's courthouse and jail, where the fallout from a revenge killing and the coal wars lingers.

Tracking down the screaming ghost of legislator Cassius Marcellus Clay, who allegedly wanders the halls of the fabled White Hall manor; the team does a thorough investigation and looks inside the life of this unyielding political figure.

Study the branches of a haunted family tree at Brennan House in Louisville, Kentucky. Learn why the successful, childless clan that grew up there always returned home to die, and watch as the team tries to find out if they've never really left.

For more than 200 years, treasure hunters have been coming to Oak Island in search of a treasure that has so far eluded them all, and has even cost six men their lives, could it be, as legend suggests, the treasure is protected by a deadly curse.

A look at how some people live through the impossible such as plane crashes, freezing temperatures, or performing superhuman feats while in danger; remarkable tales of human survival force others to reconsider what is known about the will to live.
A dog that can detect cancer faster than doctors can do it by using sophisticated equipment; a horse that can read minds; birds that can sense disaster days before it happens.

A look at what could cause once-thriving groups of people to just abandon their great cities, never to return; modern scientific knowledge may be able to help answer the unsolved questions surrounding these lost civilizations.

Dracula, Lycaon of Arcadia, the Beast of Gévaudan; these are the names of grotesque monsters who have reared their terrifying heads throughout history, unearthly creatures that thrived on human blood and flesh.

Stories of escape that defy explanation; Harry Houdini pulls off escape acts; an attempted prison break from Alcatraz Federal Penitentiary; one man receives guidance that allows him to escape the South Tower of the World Trade Center on 9/11.

st: Mysterious Lights in Moab and More
d: A Bigfoot enthusiast captures evidence of the legendary cryptid's elusive cousin -- the Ohio Grassman; mysterious glowing orbs manifest in the Utah desert; a haunted doll torments a Canadian family.

st: Ghost Girl in Chicago Bar and More
d: A dark entity shows itself to investigators inside one of America's haunted homes; the ghost of a young girl materializes in an Illinois bar; a father and son in California film a UFO that appears to be alive.

st: Inside the Screaming House and More
d: U.K. investigators are confronted by a dark presence in an abandoned home; Bigfoot stalking two brothers in Rochester, N.Y.; a smoke break in San Juan turns into a double UFO sighting.

st: Green Creature in Aruba Cave and More
d: A party store in Mexico is plagued by a malicious entity; a treasure hunt is interrupted by Bigfoot in New Mexico; a mysterious green creature lurks inside a cave in Aruba.
